# OTPInput

OTPInput is a component of `@kozmos-ds/react` whose docs do not describe it yet.

- **Import:** `import { OTPInput } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Components
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/components-otpinput--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { OTPInput, ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function OTPInputExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <div className="w-80">
        <OTPInput
          helperText="Enter the code we sent."
          label="Verification code"
          length={6}
          value="135826"
        />
      </div>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## OTPInput

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `OTPInputProps`, which extends `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "onChange">`.

- `disabled`: `boolean`, optional.
- `error`: `boolean | string`, optional.
- `helperText`: `string`, optional.
- `label`: `string`, optional.
- `length`: `number`, optional, default `6`.
- `onChange`: `(value: string) => void`, optional.
- `readOnly`: `boolean`, optional.
- `status`: `InputStatus`, optional, default `"default"`.
- `value`: `string`, optional.
- `wrapperClassName`: `string`, optional.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the 262 attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

### InputStatus

From `@kozmos-ds/react`.

type InputStatus = "default" | "error" | "warning" | "success";
